integrity: The all-order proof uses an exact determinant factorization, Lam--Leung's published weight theorem for vanishing sums of roots of unity, and explicit singular witnesses. Computations use exact arithmetic and are supplied for replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the row pattern \(\{0,1,3,4\}\). Finite replay is supportive rather than an infinite proof, and differently phrased or unindexed prior work remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact full-spark criterion for the four-row Fourier pattern \(\{0,1,3,4\}\)
